value.name: Rosa silently permits Lucia to speak
value.description: Rosa studies the two script variants, then gives Lucia a slow nod that signals permission without asking questions.
evidence: Rosa's eyes moved from the diverging script to Lucia's fingertip where it rested on the looser stroke, and she gave a single slow nod, glancing once at Asha and once back, asking nothing and refusing nothing.

value.name: Lucia identifies the looser script as her mother's
value.description: Lucia reveals that the looser handwriting on the page belonged to her mother, speaking carefully as if the words might slip away.
evidence: "The looser one," she said, almost under the radiator's tick, "that was my mother's."
Her finger did not lift from the page after she said it; it pressed a little, as if to keep the words from sliding off.

value.name: Asha holds back and lets the revelation settle
value.description: Asha keeps her hands still and allows Lucia's confession to hang between them without interrupting.
evidence: Asha kept her own hands open on the desk and did not move them, letting the sentence sit there between the two sheets

value.name: Asha separates the overlapping sheets and asks about the other hand
value.description: Asha adjusts the papers to compare the two scripts and asks Lucia which hand wrote the firmer line.
evidence: Asha eased the overlapping sheets a quarter inch apart, just enough to set the firmer l beside the looser one under the lamp, and lifted her eyes to Lucia's.

value.name: Lucia hesitates before answering
value.description: Lucia meets Asha's gaze but does not immediately respond, seeming to weigh whether naming the second hand will force her to reveal more.
evidence: Lucia's gaze rose slowly from the page to meet hers, holding there with something tight behind the eyes, as though deciding whether naming the second hand would oblige her to say more than she had come prepared to say.
Lucia did not answer at once

value.name: Rosa steadies Lucia and watches the hall
value.description: Rosa moves closer, places a supportive hand on Lucia's back, and checks the hall door as if expecting someone to arrive soon.
evidence: Rosa shifted in beside her and laid a hand low against Lucia's back, steadying her without pressing, then cut a quick look toward the hall door, where no footstep had yet sounded but soon would.

value.name: Lucia remains silent as tension builds
value.description: Lucia keeps her finger on her mother's script and does not answer while the firmer line waits under the light, leaving the moment unresolved.
evidence: her finger stayed on her mother's stroke, and the firmer line waited under the light for her to
